title: Sobolev spaces in infinite dimensions
summary: The classical theory of Sobolev spaces in finite dimensions is well established. Because infinite-dimensional spaces possess inherent analytical and topological complexities, developing a theory of Sobolev spaces for functions of infinitely many variables---rather than merely extending the classical finite-dimensional theory---is far from routine and has led to long-standing open problems. In this paper, we establish such a theory and systematically determine the extent to which these classical results can be carried over to this setting.
